measured.winding_rule: every triangle's three face-normal-versus-vertex-normal dots are >= 0.0; a zero-area triangle agrees vacuously (it emits no fragments under either winding). The single near-degenerate sliver, body tri 588 (area 4.5e-9, dots exactly 0.0), passes this rule and would fail a strict > 0.0 one; the six exactly-degenerate body tris pass it vacuously.
measured.weld_note: positions rounded to 1e-3 (a millimetre on a metre-scale car; sub-mm differences are exporter float dust) give body 358 distinct positions with edge-valence histogram {2: 1056} and 168 per wheel. Rounding to 1e-6 instead splits two near-coincident pairs (360 distinct, six valence-1 edges), which is why the tolerance is recorded here and not left to whoever re-measures.
measured.bounds_note: rounded to the printed decimals; the tool compares with 1e-4 tolerance. The whole-model baked Y minimum is -1.2e-8 (float dust at the wheels' contact), not exactly 0; Z is asymmetric by 25 mm (the body's -0.025 node translation), preserved and asserted, not corrected.
